svg.title: Index Translator server components, sentences and web pages
svg.desc: The app asks the segmentation engine for sentence ends and for paragraph or sentence alignment. The engine starts its worker thread on the first request, which loads ONNX Runtime through the bindings file and runs SaT for sentence ends and LaBSE for the embeddings that the alignment step matches. The alignment step is the dynamic programme of the AIlign paper. A web page is opened by its own module in a headless browser, and a script that runs inside the page turns it into Markdown. The two share nothing but the process. sentence ends: src/app.ts → src/segment.ts → src/segment-worker.ts → src/onnxruntime-ffi.ts → ONNX Runtime. a web page: src/app.ts → src/webpage.ts → src/page/extract.ts.

g.text: allowed hosts, one view per fetch
